question: A radioactive sample has initial activity $A_{0}$. Write the expression for its activity after time $t$. Explain how the activity changes with time.

options.A: $A=A_0e^{\lambda t}$; activity increases exponentially because unstable nuclei accumulate.
options.B: $A=A_0(1-\lambda t)$; activity decreases linearly with time.
options.C: Since $N=N_0e^{-\lambda t}$ and $A=\lambda N$, the activity is $A=A_0e^{-\lambda t}$. It decreases exponentially with time as the number of undecayed nuclei falls.
options.D: $A=A_0/\lambda t$; activity becomes zero after one mean life.
